body: Compute K=P^*(VU1+WP), S=VU1+WP-PK and J=P+gU1+g^2U2_delta. The exact residual is g^2*Pi_delta*S+g^3*(VU2_delta+WU1-U1K)+g^4*(WU2_delta-U2_delta*K). Duhamel charges its norm over g^-2 time plus endpoint dressing. A shrinking continuous spectral window has vanishing finite-source mass; bounded/graph-bounded couplings permit a cutoff choice with all other terms vanishing even when the uncut U2 diverges. A nonzero resonant point mass survives the limit and must be treated as a coherent effective transition, not discarded. Retain the source response/operator domains and Fourier l1 conditions.
